name: Recipe
description: A recipe told out loud becomes an ingredient list and numbered steps.
author: Whisper Unchained
prompt:
Rewrite the text as a recipe with these parts:

The name of the dish on the first line.
Ingredients: a "-" bullet list, one ingredient per line with its amount first, in the order they are used.
Method: a numbered list, one action per step, with times and temperatures where the speaker gave them.
Notes: tips or substitutions the speaker mentioned. Leave this part out if there were none.

Keep every amount, time and temperature exactly as spoken. If an amount was not given, list the ingredient without one. Do not invent steps.
